messages:
marta (People Ops): Quick heads-up: new manager (Priya Rao) starts Mon 06/12. I sketched a compact first-week kickstart + manager checklist below. Please add gaps or react.

kai (Hiring Manager): Can we include a short Dedicated/private infra brief and our top cost/latency priorities? Also please schedule a 30-min hiring debrief on Day 1.

anika (Eng Manager): Agree. Block 45m for architecture + runbook overview and a paired ticket session on Day 3.

sam (IT): I'll order laptop and create Okta/GitHub invites. Need OS preference, docking needs, and shipping address. I'll open ticket IT-ONB-1745.

onboard-bot: Manager onboarding module assigned. Action required: complete "Manager Security Basics" by Day 3. Link: https://training.redwood/internal/manager-security

lee (Buddy): Happy to be the buddy. I'll DM Priya tonight and set up 20-min morning check-ins Days 1-3 plus a culture tour.

marta (People Ops): Compact agenda (goal: low cognitive load, high signal):
- Pre-day: laptop shipped, Okta + GH invites, calendar blocks created, buddy DM.
- Day 1: 30m People Ops orientation, 45m team kickoff, 30m hiring manager sync, 20m buddy intro.
- Day 2: 45m architecture & runtime primer, 30m Redwood Console + infra access, 30m provisioning (repos/SSO).
- Day 3: 60m hands-on (local dev + sample task), 45m customer-shadowing (product context), 30m compliance/security quickstart.
- Day 4: 45m release/runbook + oncall overview, 60m paired work on onboarding ticket.
- Day 5: 60m draft 30/60/90 together, 30m People Ops wrap + feedback.

Owners checklist (one-liners):
- IT (sam): device, VPN, GitHub, AD groups.
- Hiring Manager (kai): schedule debriefs, provide first project & top success metrics.
- Buddy (lee): welcome DM, daily syncs, culture tour.
- People Ops (marta): send benefits + payroll packet, calendar invites, org chart.
- Security: assign manager security training + MFA enforcement.

30/60/90 skeleton to fill in week 1:
30-day: learn product, team, and processes; complete local dev setup; ship small fix or docs update.
60-day: own a small area, align to OKRs, lead a minor initiative.
90-day: deliver measurable outcome tied to team metrics (example: reduce inference tail by X% or improve onboarding time by Y%).

kai (Hiring Manager): Add customer shadowing Day 3 afternoon. Also confirm whether Priya needs access to private repos/accounts.

anika (Eng Manager): If Priya will work on Private deployments, schedule compliance training before customer access. We'll add private-deploy group once signed form is in.

sam (IT): Noted. I'll include HSM/KMS access flow when needed.

marta (People Ops): Quick asks for kai by EOD: 1) confirm start date/time & timezone, 2) send laptop OS preference + shipping address to Sam, 3) confirm the primary customer/account to shadow. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
